definitions.ask: Should an accepted-but-failed gate turn stay in the awaiting-human bucket rather than Failed?
definitions.why: The gate is recoverable and still owns its workspace, so it must not look terminal

choices.label: Same bucket as a pending gate plus a red failure glyph; cleanup keeps treating it as live
Failed bucket; louder, but cleanup flows must be audited to skip claim-holding gates

definitions.ask: Should reclaim resurface a dismissed gate-failure notification once while the failure is current?
definitions.why: The inbox is the attention channel, and a failed gate otherwise holds its workspace forever

choices.label: Resurface it once, an hour after dismissal, while the gate still holds its workspace
Row-level attention only; a dismissed failure stays dismissed
